features.name: Using AI to build presentations
features.description: Jeremy discusses building talks with AI tools, while emphasizing the importance of not becoming a 'meat proxy' by simply passing AI output along without personal growth and critical thinking.
caveats: Risk of becoming a meat proxy by passing AI output without value-add
Personal growth must be part of the process

features.name: Talk deck as receipt philosophy
features.description: Jeremy explains that presentation decks are just a receipt; the real goal is to help the audience leave thinking about specific ideas and being able to apply those to their work.

features.name: Talk structure using anchors and accordion topics
features.description: A presentation methodology where talks are structured with individual anchor moments at specific times, with accordion topics (stretchable sections) at the end of each moment to allow flexibility in pacing without losing the narrative.

features.name: Using slides as anchors rather than scripts
features.description: Treating slide decks as prompts and anchors for memory rather than scripts to read directly, allowing speakers to engage with the audience while remembering key points.
caveats: Requires practice to speak from slides rather than reading them

features.name: AI-powered talk evaluation using audio and presentation materials
features.description: Using AI tools to analyze recorded talk audio combined with slide decks to evaluate whether key points were effectively communicated and identify opportunities for improvement.

features.name: Windows multi-clipboard for preloaded content
features.description: Using Windows multi-clipboard feature to pre-load text snippets, prompts, and information that can be quickly pasted during live presentations to avoid typing while presenting.
caveats: Similar functionality exists on Mac but specific details not provided

features.name: Prepared AI session walkthroughs
features.description: Pre-recording and saving AI agent sessions to demonstrate functionality without live waiting for responses, avoiding progress bars and ensuring reliable demonstrations during presentations.
caveats: AI responses can take 30-60 seconds; live demonstrations may not work reliably

features.name: Flexible talk composition using index cards or post-it notes
features.description: Organizing talks using individual note cards or post-it notes to identify important points, sequence content, and distinguish between essential and flexible material, allowing for dynamic adjustments based on audience response.

features.name: Reading the room and flexible content selection
features.description: Gauging audience needs and knowledge level early in presentations to dynamically select which pain points and topics to emphasize, while maintaining the core narrative structure.
caveats: More challenging in virtual meetings or webinars where audience visibility is limited

features.name: Accordion content structure for talks
features.description: Optional material sections that can flex in duration without losing the main message. Allows speakers to adapt delivery based on time constraints and audience needs while maintaining core narrative.

features.name: AI-assisted talk building with Claude
features.description: Using Claude AI to help structure and iterate on talk content through an agentic workflow. Took 24 conversation turns to prepare this specific webinar talk, with stages of time blocking, markdown review, and deck refinement.
caveats: AI asks good questions and builds frame but speaker provides all components that make the talk theirs

features.name: Four-gate talk preparation framework
features.description: A structured workflow with four stages: time blocking and brainstorming, markdown slide layout, deck building, and review-practice-delivery. Each stage has defined costs of change and decision points before moving to the next.

features.name: Copilot for PowerPoint tasks
features.description: Using Copilot to find and replace problematic fonts in PowerPoint presentations. The speaker used Copilot to fix 237 presentation issues in 30 seconds.
caveats: Requires knowing the shape of output needed, not the process

features.name: Talk evaluation kit
features.description: A local model tool that records audio, generates transcripts using Whisper library, and analyzes speaker metrics including pacing, fillers, pauses, and comparison to other speakers. Provides detailed analysis reports on speaking effectiveness.
caveats: May suggest improvements that don't align with speaker style
Terminology can be AI-generated rather than natural

features.name: Talk performance metrics analysis
features.description: Tool provides analysis of speaking pace in words per minute, engagement level with audience, filler word usage, and extraction of core concepts being communicated. Compares speaker performance against other speakers.
caveats: Tool language suggestions may not match speaker intent
